name: Scammells Barber Shop
lead: Expert haircuts, beard grooming and luxury hot towel shaves, with customers from all over the West Country. By appointment only.

experience.title: From a son's first haircut to retired gentlemen
experience.text: We welcome all ages. Our highly skilled barbers use top-quality products from around the world, including Reuzel, Layrite, Kent Brushes, Proraso and Mariner Jack, all available to buy after your visit.

items: Beard trim with hot towel line-out

currency_note: Appointments only, so book ahead to secure your chair.

special.title: The hot towel line-out
special.text: Hot and cold towels, balms and a cut-throat razor: our beard trim with hot towel line-out is the finishing touch our regulars come back for.

reviews: It was the first time I had been there and Andy did a great job sorting a very long overdue haircut, it had got far too long after an extended hospital stay and made to feel at home. Definitely will be back.
Lucy was great with my son, who is super anxious about hair cuts! She was super kind to him and helped him feel at ease. His hair looks great - thank you!.
Probably the best hair cut I've had. I had extremely long hair but Lucy sorted it perfectly and quickly.
Lucy does a spot on job as always and I’ve been using Scammells now for the past 4 years and would recommend anyone to go there to get a great haircut.
address: 47 Broad Street, Staple Hill, Bristol BS16 5LS
